style.desc: Windows 11 dark mode; mica-tinted dark title area, near-black layered surfaces, rounded 8px corners, Segoe UI Variable labels, accent-colored selection indicator bars, thin subtle strokes

arrange.text: The label sits above the horizontal track, with the value readout at the track's right end.

description: Drag slider thumbs to target values
sample: Aim for 373 on “Warmth” (±7). Only drag the handle (no clicking on the track).
identity: A slider task uses labeled handles, value readouts, and sometimes player controls or star ratings to set requested values.
screen: A labeled horizontal slider shows one handle on a track and its current value in a readout.
never: A second handle on the scored track
hint: Show a horizontal slider with visible draggable thumb, readable endpoints and read-only current value. Target is in range and thumb is off target. No editable numeric field.
